verdicts.reason: Both break the design in the same way. The wind-turbine icon and the green, blue and red triangles are squashed into a tiny unreadable strip on the left, so the main image is lost. Two oversized loose diagonal lines take over the lower half and leave large dead areas, and the headline sits off-centre on the right with no relationship to the icon. B is marginally less bad: its 'ENERGY / FOR FUTURE / SUMMIT' line breaks read more naturally than A's 'ENERGY FOR / FUTURE', and its text block is more compact. B still has the same shrunken-strip and empty-space failures.
